core.intensity_decision: Jo, 12 Oct 2026: pooled 1.0 for unseen councils; development range as sensitivity

collision_modifiers.use: multiply a bundle's rate by modifier[council or pooled][true|false] for each member listed here, using the record's collision flag (flags_v2.collision_flags). Unseen council: pooled. p_exact_given_hit_real is how often a real record whose drop could collide actually equals the other UPRN's string: the rest differ elsewhere (locality, punctuation, other edits). Use it as the verify target: when a realised record collides more often than this, keep the collision with probability p_exact_given_hit_real / synthetic share, else add a house-style difference or redraw.
